limitations: 26 confidently visible balls across 240 samples (10.8% coverage). Many supplemental windows also contain stoppages; netting, blur and camera framing limit localization. Supplemental windows were reserved after observing low visibility in the first v2 review, before any v2 learned predictions were viewed; report separately from that initial test. Correlated short clips, not independent human ground truth; insufficient to establish whole-video reliability. Unknown excluded, not negative.
center_match: Within max(4, min(12, mean reviewed box half-size)) original pixels of reviewed point. Each extra or mismatched detection on a visible-ball frame is false positive; unknown frames are excluded.
